items.title: A rational surface singularity with a dualizing complex is made Gorenstein by blowups in singular closed points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain defining a rational singularity and admitting a dualizing complex there is a finite sequence of blowups in singular closed points with all terms normal such that the dualizing sheaf of the last term is invertible (statement lines 2687-2699). The proof (proof lines 2701-2743) produces a blowup making the strict transform of the dualizing module invertible, dominates it by normalized blowups, checks invertibility at regular and singular points through the comparison maps, and concludes using torsion freeness. H3: a two-stage construction with a pointwise verification, written out in full.
